classification.difficultyReason: Select convenient input values for five supplied linear rules, calculate coordinates and draw all lines on a common plane with consistent axes/scales; familiar taught multi-step procedure with no new proof or modelling.

content.prompt: On a single set of axes, draw the graphs of:

spec.description: ONE common native blank graph response area for all five supplied linear rules.
spec.mathematics: Unlabelled blank grid only; students choose axes/scales.

answer.worked: Substitute $x=-1,0,1$ into the rule to obtain $y=-1,0,1$. Plot $(-1,-1),\ (0,0),\ (1,1)$ and draw the straight line on the same axes as the other parts.
Substitute $x=-1,0,1$ into the rule to obtain $y=5,0,-5$. Plot $(-1,5),\ (0,0),\ (1,-5)$ and draw the straight line on the same axes as the other parts.
Substitute $x=-4,0,4$ into the rule to obtain $y=1,0,-1$. Plot $(-4,1),\ (0,0),\ (4,-1)$ and draw the straight line on the same axes as the other parts.
Substitute $x=-3,0,3$ into the rule to obtain $y=-2,0,2$. Plot $(-3,-2),\ (0,0),\ (3,2)$ and draw the straight line on the same axes as the other parts.
Substitute $x=-4,0,4$ into the rule to obtain $y=5,0,-5$. Plot $(-4,5),\ (0,0),\ (4,-5)$ and draw the straight line on the same axes as the other parts.

spec.description: All five complete lines on one plane; editable per-part style key, no ink-overlapping curve legend.
